name: Boot-window check-in when the saved network is not in range: gives up early with WiFi off, then the saved network is used again
reviewer_setup: Same setup as t392-boot-window-bt-after.json (local_test build, saved WiFi, linked, cloud base on a LAN test-mode site, battery above 3.6 V and 20 %). The test-only `cloud ssid absent` makes scheduled sessions look for a network name that does not exist, without touching the saved settings; `cloud ssid saved` undoes it. Run python test/bench/cf_replay.py test/bench/cases/t392-boot-window-no-network.json --port <PORT>. The reported total_ms is the absent-network bail time.

steps.matches: \[checkin\] reason=boot join_ms=0 total_ms=[0-9]+ result=error err=(no-network|join) heap_min=[0-9]+ largest_min=[0-9]+ wifi=off
